text: Dev's housewarming is sometime next week, he'll confirm the day. New flat in Walthamstow, two bed, finally got a garden.
Astrid has a second interview at the architecture firm on Thursday. She's really nervous about the presentation part. Text her good luck that morning.
pick up dry cleaning, return the parcel, renew car insurance before end of the month
Mandla invited us to his 40th, Saturday the 8th at the Crown. His wife Naledi is doing a surprise slideshow so don't mention it.
Khadija didn't get the NHS admin job. Gutted, she'd done two rounds. Says she's going to apply for the Leeds one instead, deadline early November.

Just got off the phone with Abebe. He applied for the head chef role at Bianchi's and hears back sometime next week. Loves cooking Ethiopian food at home, does injera from scratch. I should ask how it went once he's heard.
Jonah and Freya hosting dinner Friday, I'm bringing dessert. Freya's vegetarian, Jonah eats anything.
Agnieszka's leaving do got cancelled, her manager's off sick. Might be rescheduled after half term.
Emil - interview at Sato & Co tomorrow 10am. Ring him afterwards to see how it went.

Voice note. Um, Chloe mentioned her sister Jada just got engaged, the party's sometime in early March, probably in Bristol. Chloe's going to be maid of honour and she's a bit overwhelmed already. Need to message Jada congrats this week.
Adebayo's dog Biscuit had her op yesterday, all fine. He's working from home for the rest of the week to keep an eye on her.
Deepa wants a proper chef's knife for her birthday, she's been hinting for ages. Birthday's the 23rd.
Amy starts at the council on Monday. Finally! Send her a card the day before.
Booked dentist for the 4th, 2:30. Also need to sort passport renewal over the summer at the latest.
Vikram and Divya are having a barbecue end of the month for their anniversary, ten years. Get them a bottle of something nice.
Milan says the bakery job fell through, they gave it to someone internal. He seemed fine about it honestly. Still doing nights at the warehouse.
Matteo's applying for a masters in Bologna, wants to start next autumn. His mum's from there.
sophie bday drinks thurs, im going straight from work. she said no presents but she's obsessed w that candle shop
Sana has her citizenship interview on the 12th and she's been really anxious, barely sleeping. Don't forget to check in on her the night before and then again a few days after.
Blessing's brother Kalani just moved back from Dubai and Blessing's throwing him a welcome home dinner sometime next weekend. I'm on drinks duty.
Freya (Frey) - graduation ceremony 15th Dec, her parents flying in from Oslo. Congratulate her on the day.
Siddharth has a phone screen with Zhou Logistics on Wednesday, then an in person round a week after if it goes well. He hates interviews, gets really shaky. Text him Tuesday night.
Zoe said the housewarming's off, the move fell through at the last minute. She's staying at her dad's for now.
Note to self: cancel the gym membership, fix the bike light, and get Ignacio's present sorted before Saturday.
Javier's daughter got into the drama school she auditioned for! Starts in September. Javier is beyond proud.
Ethan was made redundant last week. Has a meeting with HR on Friday about the package. He's putting a brave face on it but I can tell he's struggling. Call him sometime over the weekend.
Omar loves vintage synths, collects old Rolands. Works in sound design for games. Married to Neha, they've got two kids.

Neha's mum is in hospital again, heart thing, second time this year. Neha's flying to Lahore on Sunday and won't be back until sometime mid November. Omar is staying here with the kids and juggling work, he sounded exhausted. Neha's worried sick but trying to stay practical. Drop round a lasagne for Omar this week and message Neha a few days after she lands.

Lunch with Dev. He's had enough of agency life and started applying for product manager roles, has three applications out and one first round next Tuesday with a fintech. Seems calm about it. Also training for the Brighton half marathon in April, running five mornings a week, and his knee is playing up. Remind me to ask about the interview the day after.

Astrid got the job!! Rang me screaming from the car park. It's the senior designer role at the architecture firm she interviewed with twice, more money and only a twenty minute cycle. Starts the 1st of next month. Her mum's already told the entire family. Need to organise celebration drinks with the team sometime that week, and get her a nice notebook for the first day.
Mandla's dinner party went really well. His mum made the lamb. I should send him a thank you text tomorrow.
Grocery run, then hoover, then finish the cover letter for the Costa role by Friday. Submit it Thursday night if I can.
Khadija's cat Pepper went missing over the weekend. She's in pieces. Printed posters this morning. Check in with her tonight.

Dictated. So Abebe and his partner Kalani are hosting Diwali at theirs, no wait, it's a joint Diwali and housewarming thing, first Saturday in November. Their kids are doing the decorations. Bring sweets, they're nut free because the little one has an allergy.

Jonah had his final interview at the bank today, the one he's been chasing since the summer. Thinks it went badly, he blanked on a technical question about risk models and then rambled. His girlfriend Amy reckons he's overthinking it. Hears back end of the week. He's already looking at other roles just in case. Message him Friday afternoon either way, and maybe suggest a pint over the weekend.
Agnieszka is pregnant! Due early March. Her husband Emil is already painting the nursery.

ok so Chloe's work christmas party is the 19th and she wants me as her plus one. dress code is black tie, ugh. it's at some hotel in town, starts at 7, and her boss apparently does a speech that goes on forever. she's also nervous because her ex works there now. hire a suit sometime next week and book a taxi for the way back
Jada failed her driving test again, third time. Retaking it sometime in January. She's sick of the whole thing.
Adebayo O'Brien - new neighbour two doors down. Teacher at the primary, has a golden retriever called Mango. Invited us for drinks next Friday.
Deepa's dad retires at the end of the month after 35 years at the post office. There's a do at the social club the evening after. Card from all of us.
Bank. Pharmacy. Post office. Pay council tax.
Amy's interview for the deputy head post is next Wednesday. She's prepped loads and feels good about it. She'll know by the end of that week.
naledi + mandla housewarming sat, bring plant? they've got a cat so nothing toxic
Vikram's applying to be a firefighter, fitness test early next year. Been at the gym every morning. His wife Divya thinks he's mad.
Divya's sister Sophie is getting married in Lisbon over the summer, sometime in July. Divya's doing the hen.

Long chat with Milan on the walk home. His dad passed away last month and the funeral was in Prague, he's only just back. Says he's coping but not sleeping, and work have been decent about leave. He's going back full time sometime next week. Really need to check in with him at the weekend and maybe take him out for food the week after. He likes Korean BBQ.
Matteo has his PhD viva on the 3rd. Wish him luck the day before, then send congrats afterwards if he passes.
Sana Usman - recruiter at Reyes Partners. Said she'll put me forward for the operations role. Follow up with her if nothing by mid next week.

Blessing's 30th! Saturday 22nd, dinner at the Thai place on the high street then karaoke afterwards, booked till 1am. Her boyfriend Omar is sorting the cake. She's dropped about four hints about a fancy hair dryer, the Dyson one, so chip in with Zoe and Freya. Also she's off gluten at the moment so tell the restaurant the day before.
Ignacio is nervous about the panel interview at the hospital on Monday. Doctors on the panel apparently. He's applying for a senior nurse role. Text him that morning.
Javier's leaving drinks were last night. Ask him how the first week at the new place goes, sometime the week after next.
Ethan and his wife Zoe celebrating their engagement with a garden party at her parents', end of September next year. Save the date coming.
Omar says Neha got promoted to head of marketing. Starts the new role after Christmas.

Spent the afternoon updating my CV and rewriting the personal statement, which took forever. Two applications in, three to go before the end of the month. The Zhou Logistics one has an interview on the 6th so interview prep sometime this weekend, practise the STAR answers out loud. Also buy a new shirt and check the train times the day before.

Siddharth's grandad turns 90 on Sunday, big family lunch at a restaurant in Southall. Siddharth's organising the cake and the photo slideshow. He's a bit stressed, the family is huge, his aunt keeps changing the guest list and two cousins aren't speaking. He asked if I could help pick up the cake that morning. Check in with him the day after to see how it went.
Dev cancelled the games night, his boss dropped a deadline on him. Reschedule for early December.
Freya's moving to Edinburgh sometime in the spring for a lectureship. Must take her out for a goodbye dinner before she goes.
Kalani got his results, passed the bar exam! Party at his parents' sometime next month. Send congratulations today.
Astrid's boyfriend Matteo is planning a surprise party for her 35th, three weeks on Saturday. Don't tell her. Help with decorations the morning of, and he asked if I can do a speech.
Quiet one. Didn't really talk about anything, Neha just wanted to vent about the commute. Lives out in Croydon now.
